Ensuring Healthcare for All | Congressman Robert Garcia Skip to main content Ensuring Healthcare for All Even after the incredible progress made by the Affordable Care Act, more than 30 million Americans still don’t have health insurance. Congressman Garcia knows that healthcare is a human right, and Congress must pass Medicare for All to ensure our country finally achieves affordable, high quality medical coverage for all. Congressman Garcia believes it is unacceptable that medical bills continue to be the leading cause of personal bankruptcy for our residents, and that we must fight to expand benefits so that every American has access to dental and vision coverage, and the preventative care to protect people’s lives and health.   More on Ensuring Healthcare for All Congressman Robert Garcia Hosts Panel Discussion on the Lessons Learned from the COVID-19 Pandemic August 26, 2024 Press Release Long Beach, CA – Today, Congressman Robert Garcia (CA-42) hosted a panel of experts in public health and pandemic response to discuss the lessons learned from COVID-19 and what needs to be done to prepare for future pandemics. Supporting Small Businesses | Congressman Robert Garcia Skip to main content Supporting Small Businesses Small businesses are the backbone of our economy and a vital part of the fabric of our communities. They are living proof of the American Dream—driving innovation, creating local jobs, and strengthening our nation’s competitiveness in the global marketplace. These businesses not only provide the goods and services we use every day, but they also foster community pride and fuel economic growth. That’s why we must continue to ensure that small business owners have the tools they need to succeed in an increasingly competitive world. I will continue working to secure supply chains against destructive tariffs, protect competition in the marketplace, expand access to capital, and safeguard the federal services and programs that so many small businesses rely on. Ending the Gun Violence Epidemic | Congressman Robert Garcia Skip to main content Ending the Gun Violence Epidemic Congressman Garcia knows we must also take action to save lives and finally bring an end to America’s epidemic of gun violence. He believes Congress needs to come together and pass legislation that mandates universal background checks for all firearm purchases, bans assault-style weapons, prohibits gun ownership by those under the age of 21 and establishes a strong federal licensing system. He understands that we must also ensure that Congress enact and enforce red flag laws—a proven measure to prevent gun crimes before they occur—and provide local communities and organizations with the tools necessary to address the causes of gun violence—especially in our most marginalized neighborhoods.  More on Ending the Gun Violence Epidemic Spectrum News 1 - Garcia, Warren reintroduce AMMO Act to create safeguards around ammunition sales June 2
